direct_off_medium.style: English, indie pop, bright acoustic guitar, soft drums, warm lead vocal, polished demo mix
direct_off_medium.lyrics:
[Verse]
Audio dot cpp starts the demo tonight.
Small sparks of music glow in the light.
A local engine keeps the rhythm tight.
No cloud in the loop, just code taking flight.
[Pre-Chorus]
Every buffer finds its place.
Every model joins the race.
[Chorus]
Turn the signal into song.
Let the native runtime carry it along.
From text to melody, clear and strong.
Audio dot cpp keeps the demo moving on.

create_full_plan_medium.style: English, piano pop, clear lead vocal, gentle bass, 92 BPM, warm chorus harmonies, soft room reverb
create_full_plan_medium.lyrics:
[Verse]
A quiet room begins to sing.
The keys reply with silver rings.
A metronome is counting time.
A simple phrase becomes a line.
[Pre-Chorus]
The bass walks in with patient grace.
The melody opens more space.
[Chorus]
Hold the note and let it rise.
Morning opens up the sky.
Every word can find a place.
Every phrase can leave a trace.
[Bridge]
If the plan is clear and bright.
The song can travel through the night.

cover_melody_score_medium.style: English, jazz funk cover, warm Rhodes, round bass, light drums, relaxed vocal, clean live band feel
cover_melody_score_medium.lyrics:
[Verse]
We follow the melody line.
The rhythm keeps everything fine.
A Rhodes chord lands behind the beat.
The bass keeps walking down the street.
[Chorus]
Hold that shape and make it new.
Change the color, keep the view.
Every phrase can still belong.
When the cover turns into a song.

edit_full_score_medium.style: English, piano pop with jazz harmony, clear lead vocal, gentle bass, 92 BPM, wider chorus, tasteful drum fills
edit_full_score_medium.lyrics:
[Verse]
A quiet room begins to sing.
The keys reply with silver rings.
A brushed snare paints the second line.
The harmony turns right on time.
[Chorus]
Hold the note and let it rise.
Morning opens up the sky.
Keep the score but change the light.
Make the ending open wide.
[Outro]
Let the last chord slowly fade.
Leave the echo we have made.
